senses.gloss: तच्छील तच्छील. See तद्, p. 360, col. 1.

ताच्छब्द्य ताच्छब्द्य, अम्, n. (fr. तच्छब्द
[तद्+शब्द], having that name or the name of that),
the being called or named after that.

ताच्छीलिक ताच्छीलिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. तच्-
छील or ताच्छील्य), a N. given to an affix when it
denotes ‘having a particular inclination or custom.’

ताच्छील्य, अम्, n. the being accustomed to that,
doing anything regularly, consuetude.
